source: Reminder, Reset Type group, Merge-default/Mixed/Hard radios, Show modified files, OK/Cancel/Help.
Modified files opens CFileDiffDlg modal from HEAD to working copy.
OK closes options, then CAppUtils::MergeAbort opens separate Reset progress; Merge maps to reset type 3 / git reset --merge, Mixed/Hard reset HEAD.
Merge failure Retry reopens Abort options; Mixed/Hard Retry directly retries the selected reset.
existing_native: Nine visible roles already implemented in MergeAbortDialog; exact modes and reminder, original comparison icon.
Core Merge/Mixed/Hard modes and actual-model retry/post-actions have earlier verification in merge-abort-dialog-2026-10-08.json.
Repository factory currently overrides onShowModified with app-global modeless showRevisionComparison.

gaps.evidence: RepositoryModel.showMergeAbort opens global comparison rather than an owned modal sheet. Abort options can remain usable and close independently.
gaps.required: Owned Changed Files sheet with HEAD/working endpoints, inherited lease/appearance, child gates and exact parent/child close verification.

gaps.evidence: ApplicationDelegate has no MergeAbortWindowController busy/attached-sheet gate. Other merge controllers are distinct types.
gaps.required: Fence Quit during active abort/reset and owned comparison/progress sheets.

gaps.evidence: MergeAbortWindowModel.invalidate sets invalidated only; running Task is not cancelled and result publication/onChanged lacks an invalidated guard.
gaps.required: Cancel/reap owned reset on forced close and reject late publication/callbacks. Keep ordinary titlebar Cancel behavior.

gaps.evidence: Native options are replaced by progress in one resized window; source closes options and opens separate progress.
gaps.required: Audit/port distinct options/progress windows and mode-specific retry ownership, plus native layouts and live command output.

gaps.evidence: GitRepository.abortMerge passes its token to reset but calls isBare and rev-parse HEAD without that token.
gaps.required: Pass cancellation through every owned preflight read and verify interruption/reaping and no subsequent reset.

remaining: No physical/controller/factory or signed acceptance is established by this audit. Current model tests do not prove the missing ownership behavior. Full app port remains incomplete.
